entries.3e80bd4f5aabd1ab: Retail of Meat and Other Products
entries.6c3881418f21a83d: A holding company headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, which, together with six subsidiaries, two affiliates and one parent company (nine affiliated companies in total), forms the group. Its main business is retail sales of meat and other food products, and it also runs a restaurant business. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended January 2026 numbered 753.
entries.d663b7cd4b39998a: A holding company under S Foods that operates meat specialty retail stores and yakiniku and steak restaurants.
